# Custom Auto Gates & Fencing

> South East Queensland's premier factory-direct manufacturer and automation specialist for automatic sliding gates, swing gates, solar off-grid systems, and architectural aluminium slat fencing.

Custom Auto Gates Pty Ltd (QBCC #15579753, ABN 88 642 795 819) designs, laser measures, fabricates, powdercoats, and installs custom automatic residential and commercial gates across Brisbane, Ipswich, Logan, and Gold Coast with a 10-Year Structural Guarantee directly from our Yamanto workshop.

## Main Services & Gate Solutions

- [Automatic Sliding Gates](https://customautogates.com.au/#sliding-gates): Ground-track, cantilever trackless, and telescopic multi-panel sliding gates fabricated with heavy-duty aluminium and Italian / Centurion automation.
- [Automatic Swing Gates](https://customautogates.com.au/#swing-gates): Single leaf and double automated swing gates, including bi-fold fast-action systems for sloped and short driveways.
- [Solar Powered Off-Grid Gates](https://customautogates.com.au/#solar-gates): 100% off-grid solar automatic gate systems engineered for acreage, rural properties, and remote access points with 5-7 days battery backup autonomy.
- [Aluminium Slat Fencing & Privacy Screens](https://customautogates.com.au/#slat-fencing): Premium powdercoated horizontal and vertical aluminium slat fencing, pedestrian gates, and custom infill panels in genuine Dulux and DecoWood timber finishes.
- [Gate Motors & Hardware Showcase](https://customautogates.com.au/#motor-showcase): Heavy-duty automated gate motor kits featuring Centurion Smart (D5 Smart, D10 Smart, Vantage), Nice Italian operators, and FAAC systems with anti-crush infrared safety beams and smartphone app controls.
- [Gate Visualizer & Instant Cost Estimator](https://customautogates.com.au/#gate-visualizer): Real-time interactive gate pricing calculator with custom dimensions, materials, motors, and accessories.

## Service, Repairs & Council Compliance

- [Gate Repairs, Diagnostics & Servicing](https://customautogates.com.au/service): Emergency gate motor repairs, safety beam alignments, rack and track replacements, and preventative maintenance across Brisbane and SE QLD.
- [Queensland Council & Pool Safety Guide](https://customautogates.com.au/council-guide): Brisbane City Council and Ipswich City Council fence height regulations, boundary setback guidelines, 50% slat permeability compliance, and AS1926.1 pool gate standards.
- [Trade, Builders & Commercial Wholesale Portal](https://customautogates.com.au/trade): Dedicated builder trade pricing, CAD drawing proposals, and commercial gate fabrication for builders, architects, and civil developers.
- [Customer Reviews & Verified Case Studies](https://customautogates.com.au/testimonials): 180+ verified 5-star customer testimonials, Google reviews, and real project photos across South East Queensland.
- [Contact & Free On-Site Measure Booking](https://customautogates.com.au/contact-us): Book a 100% free on-site laser measure, request a consultation, or contact our Yamanto workshop team directly.

## Service Areas & Regional Portals

- [Brisbane Automatic Gates](https://customautogates.com.au/gates-brisbane): Automatic gate manufacturing and installations across Brisbane Inner Suburbs (New Farm, Ascot, Hamilton, Paddington, Bulimba, Indooroopilly), Northside, and Southside.
- [Ipswich & Greater Springfield Automatic Gates](https://customautogates.com.au/gates-ipswich): Factory-direct gate fabrication for Yamanto, Springfield Lakes, Brookwater, Augustine Heights, Ripley, Karalee, and Greater Ipswich.
- [Logan City & Redlands Automatic Gates](https://customautogates.com.au/gates-logan): Custom driveway gates and automated security barriers across Logan, Browns Plains, Springwood, Greenbank, and Redland Bay.
- [Gold Coast Automatic Gates](https://customautogates.com.au/gates-gold-coast): Marine-grade powdercoated sliding and swing gates for coastal environments from Hope Island to Southport and Surfers Paradise.
